about: Hand-marked key for the mock follow-up meeting (Harbor Point reopening weekly, 2026-10-26), sent with the board after the seed meeting (board-after-seed.json). As key-items.json, plus: 'thread' lists the OPEN THREADS IDs the item may continue (null = new work); 'status' lists the statuses that are right ('any' = not scored); 'waitsOn' names the key whose item this one cannot finish without. A 'done' status on any thread that no key allows to be done is a false closure.
